scripts.sync:android: tsc -b && vite build && powershell -Command "Remove-Item -Recurse -Force ../app/src/main/assets/web/* -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Copy-Item -Recurse -Force dist/* ../app/src/main/assets/web/"
scripts.sync:ios: tsc -b && vite build && powershell -Command "Remove-Item -Recurse -Force ../ios/LaEstacionGrill/web/* -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path ../ios/LaEstacionGrill/web; Copy-Item -Recurse -Force dist/* ../ios/LaEstacionGrill/web/"
scripts.sync:all: pnpm run sync:android && pnpm run sync:ios
scripts.deploy:supabase: pnpm run sync:all && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./empaquetar.ps1 && node subir_a_supabase.js
